decode_probes.state_policy: Each measured token starts from an equivalent preloaded cache state; cache growth across repetitions is forbidden.

quality.sample_basis: Declare whether samples are item scores, document/window losses, or complete suite repetitions.

numerical.sample_basis: Declare the tensor, decode step, reduction, and whether values are element-, layer-, fixture-, or run-level.

power_thermal.sample_basis: One value per complete steady-state interval of at least 600 seconds.

synchronization.policy: Synchronize immediately before starting and immediately before stopping a host timer whenever the backend can enqueue asynchronous work.

metric_definitions.graph_latency: One deployed graph invocation measured by the device/runtime profiler. It is not generation throughput.
metric_definitions.ttft_warm: From synchronized warm generation-loop entry with token IDs already available and model/artifact loaded through materialization of the first output token.
metric_definitions.request_ttft: From receipt of a complete request at the measured API boundary through availability of the first output token at that same boundary.
metric_definitions.cold_ttft: From fresh-process entry before artifact/model load through availability of the first output token; report load components separately.
metric_definitions.prefill_latency: Synchronized prompt-processor execution for exactly prompt_tokens input IDs, excluding tokenization and model load.
metric_definitions.decode_latency: One synchronized one-token decode step from an equivalent preloaded cache state.
metric_definitions.decode_time_per_output_token: Arithmetic mean of per-token decode durations for generated tokens after prefill, with EOS-shortened token count recorded.
metric_definitions.decode_throughput: actual_generated_tokens divided by summed synchronized decode time.
metric_definitions.generation_throughput_including_prefill: actual_generated_tokens divided by synchronized prefill-plus-decode generation-loop time.
metric_definitions.generation_throughput_excluding_prefill: actual_generated_tokens divided by summed synchronized decode time.
metric_definitions.request_total_latency: From receipt of a complete request through completion of the response at the measured API boundary.
metric_definitions.artifact_load_latency: Fresh-process elapsed time to open, map, deserialize, or otherwise make the deployed artifact available to the runtime, excluding model/runtime initialization that is reported separately.
metric_definitions.model_load_latency: Fresh-process elapsed time for runtime/model initialization after artifact availability and before the first inference call, excluding compilation.
metric_definitions.peak_memory: Peak observed bytes within an explicitly named memory domain and collection interval; process RSS, unified memory, accelerator allocation, and service estimates are distinct domains.
metric_definitions.average_power: Average observed watts over the declared sampling interval and measurement domain after recording whether idle baseline is subtracted.
metric_definitions.energy_per_output_token: Measured joules attributable to the declared interval divided by actual_generated_tokens; baseline policy is mandatory.
metric_definitions.quality_metric: A score from the pinned academic or authored evaluation contract; task, split, limit, harness, prompt interface, and scoring method are part of the metric identity.
metric_definitions.numerical_error: A comparison against a named reference level with tensor, reduction, dtype, tolerance policy, and decode step recorded.

statistics.rounding_policy: Compute from unrounded base-unit samples; round only presentation copies.
statistics.outlier_policy: Retain every valid sample. Never remove a sample solely because it is slow, fast, or statistically distant.
statistics.invalid_series_policy: If any measured sample is invalid, preserve it with a reason, mark the series incomplete, and rerun the complete series for headline comparison. Incomplete series may be diagnostic evidence only.

memory_policy.peak_definition: Maximum observed bytes in one named domain during one declared interval.

power_thermal_policy.claim_boundary: Omit power or thermal claims when the method cannot identify the measurement domain or sampling interval; never substitute an estimate without labeling evidence_level=estimated.

numerical_policy.tolerance_policy: Record a named, versioned tolerance policy separately for dtype conversion, export parity, backend parity, and quantized quality. Token equality is a canary, not the sole criterion.

reporting_policy.claim_scope: Every hardware number is a system result for the complete recorded device, OS, runtime, compiler, provider, artifact, precision, workload, and timing boundary.
forbidden_equivalences: Workbench graph latency equals end-to-end generation throughput
service turnaround equals device inference latency
hosted family or proxy evidence equals the named physical product
MLX execution implies Apple Neural Engine placement
comparison_requirements: Retain exact system identity for every series.
Compare only the same workload, metric definition, timing scope, units, generation policy, and statistical policy.
List hardware, software, precision, graph, cache, provider, and measurement-method differences as non-comparable dimensions.
Present context scaling and uncertainty, not one unqualified headline token rate.
